description:
Learn to build your skills and confidence. I'm Daru Dhillon, a licensed general contractor sharing outdoor projects and home upgrades in-depth tutorials for homeowners and contractors. If you are new to building, this is a great place to learn the latest in home improvement. 

I read every comment and appreciate you watching. I also appreciate you sharing your tips. Many of the tips I share are based on your concerns. 

That's the beauty of YouTube. We are all learning, helping and sharing and that is the definition of a good community in my books. I love that. Thank-you
